title: Shipping label purchases: error wrapping that loses the carrier's details
name: Carrier label errors

questions.prompt: The warehouse ops dashboard lists every failed shipment in a pick wave with carrier 'unknown', and the error logs for failed label purchases have no carrier name, HTTP status or carrier request id. Without those, on-call can't open a ticket with the carrier. The error codes and retries still work. Fix shipping/errors.ts so the tests pass.
